title: Integer Formula for a Cyclic Character
statement: For every positive integer $m$ and all integers $j,x$, the cyclic character indexed by the residue of $j$ modulo $m$, evaluated at the residue of $x$, equals $\exp\!\left(2\pi i\,\frac{jx}{m}\right)$.
